payload.description: The most recent allowances the council has published are for 2024-25, so councillors elected in May 2025 or May 2026 are not in that schedule and no figure is shown for them. The schedule gives a surname and an initial rather than a full name, so a figure is shown only where exactly one councillor matches it and the council's record has them in office during that year. Where someone served part of the year the figures are for that part, which is why some are much smaller than others.
